name: wheel-rail coupling matrices
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以矩阵形式表征车辆与轨道间轮轨接触关系的对象。
usage_overview: 用于把轮轨接触作用接入车辆与轨道的整体动力方程，纳入接触协调、蠕滑、等效刚度及不平顺输入；矩阵可随车辆位置和接触状态变化，以反映运动过程中的耦合关系。

complete_examples.text: Essentially, the key to achieve the coupled analysis between the vehicle and the tracks is deriving the wheel-rail coupling matrices.

In this work, the method presented in [23] is applied to calculate the wheel-rail interaction forces, from which wheel-rail coupling matrices are further derived by the energy variation method used in [21-22].
